rucrtrpg.markdownDescription: The Create RPG Test Suite (`RUCRTRPG`) command compiles RPGLE and SQLRPGLE source members containing test procedures into a iRPGUnit test suite service program.

tstPgm.markdownDescription:
Test program

Specifies the name of the test program (`*SRVPGM`) to create. By default, this will be set to `&OPENLIB/&OPENMBR` for source members and `&CURLIB/&SHORTNAME` for local files. The following variables can be used:

•`&OPENLIB`: Library name where the test source member lives

•`&OPENSPF`: Source file name where the test source member lives

•`&OPENMBR`: Name of the test source member

•`&CURLIB`: Current library

•`&NAME`: Name of the test file

•`&SHORTNAME`: Shortened name of the test file

•`&FULLPATH`: Full path of the file on the remote system

srcFile.markdownDescription:
Source file

Specifies the name of the source file containing a member with the same name as `TSTPGM`. By default, this will be set to `&OPENLIB/&OPENSPF` for source members. The following variables can be used:

•`&OPENLIB`: Library name where the test source member lives

•`&OPENSPF`: Source file name where the test source member lives

•`&OPENMBR`: Name of the test source member

•`&CURLIB`: Current library

•`&NAME`: Name of the test file

•`&SHORTNAME`: Shortened name of the test file

•`&FULLPATH`: Full path of the file on the remote system

srcMbr.markdownDescription:
Source member

Specifies the name of the member containing the source code to be compiled. By default, this will be set to `&OPENMBR` for source members. The following variables can be used:

•`&OPENLIB`: Library name where the test source member lives

•`&OPENSPF`: Source file name where the test source member lives

•`&OPENMBR`: Name of the test source member

•`&CURLIB`: Current library

•`&NAME`: Name of the test file

•`&SHORTNAME`: Shortened name of the test file

•`&FULLPATH`: Full path of the file on the remote system

srcStmf.markdownDescription:
Source stream file

Specifies the path name of the stream file containing the source code to be compiled. By default, this will be set to `&FULLPATH` for local files. The following variables can be used:

•`&OPENLIB`: Library name where the test source member lives

•`&OPENSPF`: Source file name where the test source member lives

•`&OPENMBR`: Name of the test source member

•`&CURLIB`: Current library

•`&NAME`: Name of the test file

•`&SHORTNAME`: Shortened name of the test file

•`&FULLPATH`: Full path of the file on the remote system

Allows you to enter text that briefly describes the RPGUnit test case and its function.

Specifies one or more directories to add to the search path used by the compiler to find copy files. The compiler will search the directories specified here if the copy files in the source program can not be resolved.

rucalltst.markdownDescription: The Call Tests (`RUCALLTST`) command runs a test suite or a test procedure.

tstPgm.markdownDescription:
Test program

Specifies the name of the test program (`*SRVPGM`). By default, this will be set to `&OPENLIB/&OPENMBR` for source members and `&CURLIB/&SHORTNAME` for local files. The following variables can be used:

•`&OPENLIB`: Library name where the test source member lives

•`&OPENSPF`: Source file name where the test source member lives

•`&OPENMBR`: Name of the test source member

•`&CURLIB`: Current library

•`&NAME`: Name of the test file

•`&SHORTNAME`: Shortened name of the test file

•`&FULLPATH`: Full path of the file on the remote system

enumDescriptions: Run test procedures in the order provided by the system API.
Run test procedures in reverse order.
order.markdownDescription:
Run Order

Specifies the order for running the test procedures. Useful to check that there is no dependencies between test procedures.

enumDescriptions: The current library list is used to execute the unit test suite.
The initial library list part of the specified job description is used to execute the unit test suite.

defaultSnippets.label: Name
defaultSnippets.description: Specify the names of the libraries to be added to user portion of the library list for the current thread.

libl.markdownDescription:
Library List

Specifies the library list for executing the specified unit test.

jobD.markdownDescription:
Job Description

Specifies the name of the job description that is used to set the library list, when the `libl` parameter is set to `*JOBD`. `*DFT` can be used here to indicate the library of the unit test suite (service program) is searched for job description `RPGUNIT`.

enumDescriptions: Full detail for failures and errors, no detail for successes.
Full detail in all cases.
detail.markdownDescription:
Report Detail

Specifies how detailed the test run report should be.

enumDescriptions: Creates a report regardless of the test result.
Creates a report in case of failures and errors, only.
Does not create any report.
output.markdownDescription:
Create Report

Specifies whether a report is created.

enumDescriptions: Resources are not reclaimed.
Resources are reclaimed after each test case and at the end of the test suite.
Resources are reclaimed at the end of the test suite.
rclRsc.markdownDescription:
Reclaim Resources

Specifies when to reclaim resources. Resources, such as open files, can be reclaimed after each test case or at the end of the test suite. This option is useful if the test suite calls OPM programs, which do not set the `*INLR` indicator.

enumDescriptions: Test case aborts execution after a failing assertion.
Test case continues execution after a failing assertion.
onFailure.markdownDescription:
On Failure

Specifies test execution behavior after a failing assertion.

Wrapper Command

Specifies a custom command to wrap the `RUCALLTST` command.

params.markdownDescription:
Parameters

Specifies the parameters for the custom command.

module.markdownDescription:
Modules

Specifies programs or service programs and optionally modules to include for code coverage.
